categories.name: الْمُنْكَرَاتُ الِاجْتِمَاعِيَّةُ فِي سُورَةِ الْفَجْرِ
categories.nameEn: Social Evils Condemned in Surah Al-Fajr

items.verseEn: No! But you do not honor the orphan
And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
And you love wealth with immense love.

categories.name: وَظَائِفُ الرِّيَاحِ
categories.nameEn: Functions of the Winds in the Quran

items.verseEn: And the winds that blow violently

items.verse: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًۭا ثِقَالًۭا سُقْنَـٰهُ لِبَلَدٍۢ مَّيِّتٍۢ فَأَنزَلْنَا بِهِ ٱلْمَآءَ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
items.verseEn: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall] until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded.

items.verse: وَٱخْتِلَـٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍۢ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَـٰحِ ءَايَـٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
items.verseEn: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.

categories.name: مَوَازِينُ الأَعْمَالِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
categories.nameEn: The Weighing of Deeds on Judgment Day

items.verse: وَٱلْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
items.verseEn: And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful.

items.verse: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَظْلِمُونَ
items.verseEn: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.

items.verse: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
items.verseEn: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
He will be in a pleasant life.

categories.name: قِصَّةُ أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ
categories.nameEn: The Story of the Garden Owners

items.verse: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
items.verseEn: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
And it became as though reaped.
So they set out, while lowering their voices,

harf.hint: A scale of balance — by which weights are made just and deeds are measured in the Hereafter
harf.arabicVerse: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
harf.verse: 11:85 - And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.

deduction.title: The Conqueror Between Two Horizons
deduction.intro: In the annals of divine guidance, one figure stands apart as both a mighty ruler and a humble servant of Allah. This individual traveled to the farthest reaches of the earth, witnessing the sun rise upon an unusual people and set in a black murky spring. Most remarkably, this servant was tasked with building an extraordinary barrier against a nation of great mischief. Can you identify this legendary figure from the Quran?
clues: I was granted power and influence in the earth by the Most Merciful
I journeyed to the place where the sun rises and where it sets
I reached a people who could scarcely understand a word
I was commanded to build an immense barrier using iron
I sealed the space between two steep mountains with molten metal
I was neither an angel nor a prophet, but a servant upon whom Allah bestowed favor

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Dhu al-Qarnayn (The One with Two Horns)
King Suleiman (Solomon)
Prophet Dhul-Kifl
Dhu al-Nun (The Fish Companion)
The Angel of the Barrier
identity.answer: Dhu al-Qarnayn (The One with Two Horns)

trial.label: The Great Task
options: Building a tower to heaven
Constructing a massive iron barrier against Yajuj and Majuj
Creating a golden throne for judgment
Digging a deep well for the righteous
Constructing a ship during a great flood
trial.answer: Constructing a massive iron barrier against Yajuj and Majuj

location.label: The Setting
options: The Land of Uzair between two rivers
The place of sunrise and the black muddy spring
The sacred valley of Makkah
The desert of Madyan
The island of Cyprus
location.answer: The place of sunrise and the black muddy spring

outcome.label: The Divine Promise
options: Eternal paradise granted immediately
The nation was destroyed by a hot wind
The barrier will last until the Day of Judgment
Freedom from death for all believers
An eternal kingdom without end
outcome.answer: The barrier will last until the Day of Judgment

deduction.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
deduction.verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)

scramble.hint: A divine promise for those who affirm Tawheed (pure monotheism) and remain firm on the straight path—they have nothing to fear in this life or the next.
scramble.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
scramble.verseEn: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
